provenance_source: carried through from the C timing layer's own results file, which compiles build/generated/build_info.h and git_info.h in. The Python layer does not re-derive these by a different route

protocol_conditions.note: the 5%-of-median limit is applied by the C layer and is not adjustable from this harness. There is no retry path, so no configuration can be re-run into validity by this code

provenance_reported_not_compared.note: INFORMATIONAL, NOT COMPARED. Regenerated at CMake configure time, so it moves on every clean build and carries no information about the machine. Reported here instead of being compared or silently dropped. W12

preflight.rule: BENCHMARK_PROTOCOL.md section 4: the fingerprint is re-verified before the first timed run of every stage, and the graphics clock lock is not optional on this machine (section 4.2)

decode|c=64|cache.note: the probe is at or above the per-sample floor, so one iteration per timed bracket and the per-iteration distribution stays observable

decode|c=64.note: the probe is at or above the per-sample floor, so one iteration per timed bracket and the per-iteration distribution stays observable

arithmetic.rate_model: relative sd = delta*sqrt(lambda/T): depends on the PER-SAMPLE DURATION T and NOT on the sample count n. More samples do not reduce it; batching divides it by sqrt(R)

w3_construction.note: every Stage 3 configuration is seconds-scale and took the single-iteration path. The batched path is built and unit-tested and is NOT exercised by a timed run in this stage

repeat_confirmation.rule: every configuration's repeat_applied, as reported by the timing driver, must equal the R this harness selected -- including R = 1. An unconfirmed bracket is never divided

records.configuration: decode, one step at context c=64 tokens, head at the last position only, KV cache USED (cache path)

statistics.invalid_reason: stddev is 19.065% of median, above the 5.0% protocol limit

records.invalid_reason: stddev is 19.065% of median, above the 5.0% protocol limit
records.validity_rule: std dev > 5.0% of median => INVALID. Applied by the C layer; never loosened, never retried, never averaged away. This harness has no retry path

construction.note: the probe is at or above the per-sample floor, so one iteration per timed bracket and the per-iteration distribution stays observable

annotations.pre_warmup_bit_identity_check: PASSED: the cached step's logits are bit-identical to the no-cache step's at the same context; a mismatch aborts the configuration untimed
annotations.kv_cache: USED: one token through the weights, attention over the cached positions
annotations.causal_mask: regenerated as a loop bound; the stored mask buffers are not read
annotations.thread_placement: pinned to logical cpu 2 of 8; priority raised (ABOVE_NORMAL class, THREAD_PRIORITY_HIGHEST)
annotations.timed_bracket_contains: model_decode_step_cached only; the cache allocation, the pre-fill of the first c-1 positions and the per-iteration length restoration are all outside it

diagnostics.diagnostic_note: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. Labelled, never reported as a result, never used to revise a VALID/INVALID verdict. The reported median and standard deviation are the C layer's, over all samples

summary.separation_note: prefill and decode are separate workloads and are never combined into one figure, at any level of this file. Prefill is compute-bound; decode is memory-bandwidth-bound

max_abs_diff_within_tolerance.worst_configuration: prefill, L=128 tokens, D3 row d3_128

correctness.note: a FAIL is recorded as a FAIL and does not stop timings already taken from being recorded as taken

regression.noise_floor_source: BENCHMARK_PROTOCOL.md section 4.1, measured by Stage 0 on 2026-09-17. USED here, not re-derived (W5)
regression.process_set_limitation: W14: the environment fingerprint does not include the process set, so this comparison does not control it. The same binary measured in the Stage 2 and Stage 3 sessions differed by roughly 9 to 12 percent on unchanged code, about 2.3 times the 4.4 percent noise floor. Any cross-session comparison below carries that shift; a comparison against an in-session control does not
regression.regression_definition: a slowdown of the median exceeding the noise floor, on a configuration VALID in BOTH files, at the SAME prompt set and the SAME configuration
regression.cannot_catch: any change smaller than the noise floor. A real regression inside 4.4% is indistinguishable from noise here and is reported as no measurable change

refusals.reason: the configuration does not appear in the prior file

counters.reason: BENCHMARK_PROTOCOL.md section 6 requires Nsight Compute counters for GPU stages from Stage 7 onward. This stage writes no kernel; the engine it times runs on the CPU, and the cuBLAS binary it re-runs is Stage 0's, already profiled in its own stage. No profiler run was introduced

nsight_counters.reason: a CPU stage. BENCHMARK_PROTOCOL.md section 6 requires Nsight counters from Stage 7 onward, and this stage writes no kernel

cpu_counters.reason: PERSISTENT.md section 8, W4: xperf is AVAILABLE on this machine and is DELIBERATELY UNUSED, following the Stage 2 and Stage 3 precedent. The consequence is stated rather than hidden: without CPU counters, the cause of the measured gap is not established at the counter level, and an issue-rate limit cannot be distinguished from a cache-miss limit

headline_ratios.reason: BENCHMARK_PROTOCOL.md section 7 defines the decode headline against measured GPU bandwidth and the prefill headline against cuBLAS at the engine's shapes. This stage's engine runs on the CPU, so the cuBLAS figures recorded here are DENOMINATORS FOR LATER STAGES and not a ratio for this one

configuration_order.note: the driver runs every configuration in ONE invocation, so this list is the order the machine saw. Each cache configuration is immediately followed by its no-cache control, so any drift within the session falls on both members of a pair (PERSISTENT.md section 8, W14)
